sloka: ततः प्रवृत्तं सुमहत् तद्युद्धं रोमहर्षणम्।निशाचरैः प्लवङ्गानां देवानां दानवैरिव ।। ६.७९.२ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pravṛttaṁ sumahat tadyuddhaṁ romaharṣaṇam।niśācaraiḥ plavaṅgānāṁ devānāṁ dānavairiva ।। 6.79.2 ।।

translations.english: Then ensued a battle between Rakshasas and Vanaras whichcaused horripilation, just like the battle between Devas and Danavas.
